name: stock-invest
description: Algo trading platform: NestJS server + React client

scripts.dev: node server/scripts/check-node.mjs && concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix server -- --preserveWatchOutput" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.setup: node server/scripts/check-node.mjs && npx -y npm@11 install && npx -y npm@11 install --prefix server && npx -y npm@11 install --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm run test:e2e --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
